listening.title: Explaining the Formal Quote to a Client

lines.speaker: Hung - Sales Executive
lines.text: Good afternoon, Ms. Trang. Did you receive the formal quote I sent yesterday?

lines.speaker: Trang - Purchasing Manager
lines.text: Yes, I did. But I have a few questions about the list price.

lines.speaker: Hung - Sales Executive
lines.text: Of course. The list price is fifty dollars for orders under one hundred units.

lines.speaker: Trang - Purchasing Manager
lines.text: And if we order three hundred? Is there a volume discount for that?

lines.speaker: Hung - Sales Executive
lines.text: Yes. At three hundred units the price drops to forty-two dollars each.

lines.speaker: Trang - Purchasing Manager
lines.text: That is better. What about the payment terms in the second section?

lines.speaker: Hung - Sales Executive
lines.text: Thirty days from delivery. We can extend that to forty-five days for long-term partners.

lines.speaker: Trang - Purchasing Manager
lines.text: Good. I also want to be sure there is no hidden charge later.

lines.speaker: Hung - Sales Executive
lines.text: None at all. The itemized breakdown on page two shows every cost clearly.

lines.speaker: Trang - Purchasing Manager
lines.text: Great. One more thing: what is the expiry date of this quote?

lines.speaker: Hung - Sales Executive
lines.text: The end of this month. If you need more time, I can revise the quote.
